concepts.headline: Comfort that doesn't fall apart.
concepts.prompt: A real photo of a white dry-erase whiteboard with a black frame standing on a wooden kitchen counter, bright kitchen softly blurred behind. On the board, everything hand-drawn in black marker: a vertical divider line down the middle. Left heading "My Hokas" / "after 6 months"; under it a simple marker sketch of a generic worn-out running sneaker (no logos, no brand marks) shaded dirty grey-brown with scribbles, a squashed flat sole, a torn upper and frayed laces, with curved arrows to labels "Flat cushion" (top) and "Torn upper" (bottom). Right heading "ComfortWear" / "after 6 months"; under it a simple clean marker sketch of a sock-style knit sneaker with bungee laces and a chunky rocker sole, a few light-blue sparkle strokes around it, with curved arrows to labels "Still supportive" (top) and "Wide toe box" (bottom). Across the bottom of the board in big marker letters: "Comfort that doesn't fall apart." and smaller under it "Ortho Stretch Cushion Shoes". In front of the board on the counter: a real pair of the black-and-purple shoes from the product reference, clean and shiny, large and sharp at true proportions. No Hoka logo anywhere, no other brand marks. All text is large, bold and high contrast for readers aged 60+; nothing small or thin.

concepts.headline: A Must Have If You Stand On Hospital Floors All Day
concepts.prompt: A casual real smartphone photo from above: a pair of the all-black shoes from the product reference lying on rumpled white bed sheets in soft daylight, one shoe slightly overlapping the other, large and sharp at true proportions. Three square yellow sticky notes stuck onto the shoes, each with black handwritten marker text: on the upper shoe "A Must Have If You Stand On Hospital Floors All Day"; on the right "40% OFF + Free Shipping Today!"; on the lower shoe "30-Day Money Back Guarantee ♡". Real, unpolished, slightly imperfect handwriting; no other text, no logos.

concepts.headline: PROBLEMS / SOLUTION
concepts.prompt: Square-ish split layout. Left half: white background, heavy black all-caps title "PROBLEMS". Below it, three stacked items, each a simple black line-art icon with a heavy black all-caps label under it: (1) a foot with small red pain lines at the heel, "HEEL PAIN BY NOON"; (2) a puffy swollen foot and ankle, "SWOLLEN FEET"; (3) toes squeezed inside a narrow shoe outline, "CRUSHED TOES". Right half: deep navy-to-blue vertical gradient, heavy white all-caps title "SOLUTION", under it a white tilted paper tag with dark script text "ComfortWear Ortho Stretch". Below, a pair of the navy shoes with bright blue accents from the product reference, large and sharp at true proportions, angled slightly, soft shadow, overlapping a little into the white half. No price, no logo. All text is large, bold and high contrast for readers aged 60+; nothing small or thin.

concepts.prompt: A screenshot of a generic retro 1990s paint-program window (grey title bar reading "untitled - Paint" with minimize/maximize/close boxes, a menu row "File Edit View Image Options Help", a narrow tool palette on the left, a color palette strip at the bottom, a grey status bar). On the white canvas, wobbly hand-drawn black mouse-drawn all-caps text on four lines: "PLEASE BUY" / "SHOES WITH ARCH" / "SUPPORT FOR YOUR" / "12-HOUR SHIFTS". Below, on the right, a pasted real product photo of one red/burgundy shoe from the product reference, large and sharp at true proportions; on the left, a wobbly hand-drawn black circle around a small rough sketch of a nurse's tired foot, and a wobbly black arrow from the circle to the shoe. No real software logos.
